session.summary: Practiced summarizing project risks and delegating action items in a mock status meeting.
weak_points: Drops articles before singular role nouns
fluency_notes: Speech was noticeably smoother in the second half of the session
next_focus: Continue article usage before role nouns

vocabulary.source_context: We should mitigate the risk before it affects the release date.
vocabulary.selection_reason: High-value professional verb for risk and project discussions.
vocabulary.meaning_english: to make something harmful, risky, or serious less severe
vocabulary.stress_note: Primary stress on the first syllable
examples: A clear rollout plan can mitigate implementation risks.
We added a fallback server to mitigate the outage risk.
vocabulary.usage_note: Common in professional, technical, and project-management discussions.

vocabulary.source_context: I will delegate the testing task to Sara.
vocabulary.selection_reason: Learner produced this correctly and it is central to the leadership goal.
vocabulary.meaning_english: to give a task or responsibility to someone else
vocabulary.stress_note: Primary stress on the first syllable
examples: I will delegate the testing task to Sara.
vocabulary.usage_note: Standard verb for assigning work to a team member.

expressions.source_context: I do not want new team members to feel singled out.
expressions.selection_reason: Useful professional expression for team communication.
expressions.meaning_english: to feel that one person is being treated differently or targeted
examples: I do not want new team members to feel singled out.

grammar_patterns.source_context: I have not received the QA report yet.
grammar_patterns.selection_reason: Learner tends to substitute the simple past for unfinished results.
grammar_patterns.pattern_name: Present perfect for an unfinished result
grammar_patterns.explanation_english: Use the present perfect when a past action's result is still relevant now.
grammar_patterns.structure: subject + have/has not + past participle + yet
examples: I have not received the QA report yet.
grammar_patterns.learner_problem: The learner tends to use the simple past for an unresolved present situation.
common_errors: I didn't received the report yet.

mistakes.source_context: I made some examples during the demo.
mistakes.wrong_sentence: I made some examples during the demo.
mistakes.corrected_sentence: I gave some examples during the demo.
mistakes.explanation_english: English uses the collocation 'give an example', not 'make an example'.
mistakes.evidence: The learner used this sentence while describing the demo.
additional_examples: Could you give me another example?

usage_events.evidence_context: The word was introduced while discussing release risk.
I will delegate the testing task to Sara.
I made some examples during the demo.
usage_events.correction: I gave some examples during the demo.

usage_events.evidence_context: Learner correctly produced 'I have not received the QA report yet' when prompted.

active_goals_add: Lead a status meeting confidently in English

weak_points_upsert.description: The learner sometimes omits articles before singular job and role nouns.
evidence: I am engineer on this project.

next_session_focus: Continue article usage before role nouns
